conviction_note: The board date (11 Nov) is confirmed on the issuer's own calendar. The release lands in session, around 16:00-16:30 local, with the call at 18:00 CET, so this window carries only the release-text reaction; the call reaction historically falls on D+1 (-7.8% on 14 Nov 2025). The two sourced findings offset: an unpriced 2027 inflation-indexation tailwind against a Q3 energy-cost drag. findings.finding: October 2026 Italian inflation printed +5.4% y/y (energy goods +31.4%). Intermonte estimates the FOI that indexes Rai Way's MSA with RAI for 2027 at 5.2-5.3%, against the ~1% their 2027 revenue estimates assume: at least +4% (EUR 10-11m) of 2027 revenue upside, net of roughly EUR 4m of energy cost. The company consensus was last updated 30 Oct, before that note, so the bar likely does not carry it.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Nothing comparable observed in this name's recent prints. Inflation indexation contributed only +1.0% to Q1 2026 revenue. The stock was flat after the 2 Nov note (4.195 on 2 Nov, 4.28 on 4 Nov, 4.22 intraday on 10 Nov).
findings.original_quote: L'inflazione in Italia si è attestata al +5,4% su base annua a ottobre ... il FOI utilizzato per l'indicizzazione dell'MSA con RAI per il 2027 possa attestarsi in area 5,2-5,3% ... potenziale upside di almeno il 4% sulle nostre stime di fatturato 2027 (circa 10-11 milioni) [translation: Italian inflation was +5.4% y/y in October; the FOI used to index the RAI MSA for 2027 could land around 5.2-5.3%; potential upside of at least 4% to our 2027 revenue estimates, about EUR 10-11m]
findings.why_not_priced: If it were priced, the company consensus would have been revised up and the stock re-rated after 2 Nov. Consensus was compiled 30 Oct and the stock is unchanged since 2 Nov, still -11% over 60 days on a ~8% yield. It is still a broker inference about a contract formula. The company has not confirmed it, and comment on it is more likely in the 18:00 call (outside the window) than in the release text, so it is sized small.
findings.independence: The ISTAT October preliminary CPI (+5.4%, energy +31.4%), reported by Teleborsa (https://www.teleborsa.it/News/2026/10/30/istat-inflazione-oltre-le-attese-a-ottobre-con-caro-energia-77.html), confirms the input. The MSA mechanism itself rests on the single broker source.

findings.finding: Energy is Rai Way's main variable cost, and 2026 power prices spiked (Intermonte: PUN averaging ~EUR 150/MWh in 2026 with a September peak near EUR 208; ~EUR 0.7m of annual EBITDA per EUR 10/MWh). The FY guide explicitly excludes ('sterilizzando') energy effects, so Q3 reported Adj. EBITDA may come in below the underlying trend and the release may need an energy caveat.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: On 30 Jul 2026 underlying EBITDA growth (+2.5m) was partly masked by energy and non-core items: d0 -0.98%, then +2.43% after the call on D+1. On 13 May 2026 the 'sostanzialmente in linea' guide with energy sterilised drew d0 -0.52%.
findings.original_quote: Sterilizzando i possibili effetti del contesto geopolitico internazionale sul prezzo dell'energia, rispetto al 2025 Rai Way prevede ora: un Adjusted EBITDA in aumento [translation: excluding the possible effects of the international geopolitical context on energy prices, compared with 2025 Rai Way now expects Adjusted EBITDA to increase]
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced: power prices are public and the 7-analyst consensus already puts FY26 Adj. EBITDA flat (192.0 vs 191.8) despite an 'in aumento' ex-energy guide. The residual is whether hedging leaves the Q3 hit larger or smaller than the street's flat-H2 assumption, which is not disclosed. Sized small and two-sided.
findings.independence: The Websim/Intermonte note of 2 Nov gives the PUN levels and sensitivity (https://www.websim.it/azioni/small-mid-cap/notizie/rai-way-inflazione-al-5-4-impatto-positivo-sulle-stime/). ISTAT energy goods +31.4% y/y in October (Teleborsa, https://www.teleborsa.it/News/2026/10/30/istat-inflazione-oltre-le-attese-a-ottobre-con-caro-energia-77.html).

outside_window.finding: RAI's (65% holder) decision on selling 10-15% of Rai Way 'could come by November'. RAI's budget assumes the sale (net debt -510m with it vs ~-600m without). An accelerated placement would be at a discount: in Feb 2021 a 10m-share ABB cost -6.6% in a day. Timing is not tied to this print, and an ABB would normally launch after a close.

The 18:00 CET conference call after the 17:30 close is where the 2027 indexation, energy and Pomezia partner questions get answered; on 14 Nov 2025 the day after the call moved -7.77% (capex slippage, no 2026-27 guide).
